image_description: A medium shot of a man and a young girl standing next to a large black plastic rain barrel outdoors. The man is on the left, wearing a white t-shirt and blue shorts, looking down at the barrel. The girl is on the right, wearing a plaid shirt, reaching towards the top of the barrel where a downspout diverter is attached. The background consists of green foliage and a white lattice fence.
